$comment: The body-type client patch. NOT PUBLISHED: it is deliberately absent from
launcher/patch-manifest.json, so no launcher applies it yet.
Two things have to happen first, in this order (ADR 0009 §6):
to confirm name_field below and the race rows in `add`.
2. The chassis decision (ADR 0008 §10). If Skirmisher moves from Shaman(7)
to Hunter(3), `keep_classes` and `add` both change — and nothing else in
the launcher does, which is the point of shipping a recipe.
And the server must reject the create packet before this hides anything, or
the screen offers combinations the realm then refuses.
`add` is the sixteen race/body-type pairs Blizzard never shipped, as
confirmed against a real client. Race ids: 1 Human, 2 Orc, 3 Dwarf,
4 Night Elf, 5 Undead, 6 Tauren, 7 Gnome, 8 Troll, 10 Blood Elf, 11 Draenei.
Night Elf needs all three: it is the race with no body type at all.
summary: Shows the three Ashmorrow body types at character creation instead of ten stock classes.
